extensionDescription.message: Filter and preview Discord messages in a floating panel and open the native confirmation for each deletion.

switchToDiscord.message: Open an existing Discord tab or start Discord from here.

chooseChat.message: Choose a text channel or direct message on this Discord tab.

setupFailed.message: Could not start the cleaner in this tab. Check the extension's site access for discord.com and try again.

openTabFailed.message: Could not open a tab. Go to discord.com and open a channel or DM.
